given: A stock record was previously filed for a given (sku, location) pair
when: The team member retrieves that (sku, location) pair later
then: The stored sku, location, quantity, and inventory_code are returned exactly as they were filed
architectural_notes: Read path: app/routes boundary -> StockService -> StockRepository read against the paired branch, so E2E. Completes the round-trip whose write half is AC1; the combined inventory_code is stored and read as one field for V1 (splitting is a later iteration).

independence.rationale: Asserts the retrieval/read-back path, distinct from AC1 which asserts the write and its confirmation; a build could confirm a write yet fail to read the record back exactly as filed.
